title: Keanu Reeves to Star in Dwarf Studios' Full-Length Stop-Motion Samurai Film Hidari
content: Japanese stop-motion animation studio dwarf studios announced on Sunday at the Annecy Animation Showcase of the 79th Cannes International Film Festival that actor Keanu Reeves will star as Jingoro Hidari in the studio's HIDARI stop-motion samurai film.

title: SHIBOYUGI: Playing Death Games to Put Food on the Table 44: Cloudy Beach Anime Film Reveals New Visual, Trailer
content: The staff of the SHIBOYUGI: Playing Death Games to Put Food on the Table 44: CLOUDY BEACH anime film began streaming a new promotional video for the movie on Sunday. The staff also revealed a new version of the visual previously unveiled in March. The film will again star Chiyuki Miura as Yuuki.

title: 'Yomi no Tsugai' Announces Additional Cast Pair
content: The official X (formerly Twitter) account of the Yomi no Tsugai ( Daemons of the Shadow Realm ) television anime announced supporting cast pair on Saturday. The anime series adapting Hiromu Arakawa 's action fantasy manga premiered on Tokyo MX, BS11, and other stations at 11:30 p.m. on April 4.

title: One of The Darkest Jump Series Is Ending This Month
content: 2026 has only just begun, and the wave of Shonen Jump cancellations has already hit several series. Last year saw many disappointing endings, especially for promising series such as Kaedegami . As it turns out, 2026 isn’t going to be any different, and we will keep seeing more cancellations than ever.

title: Drecom Announces New Indie Game Studio
content: Japanese video game developer Drecom announced on Thursday the launch of a new indie game studio Drecom Creators Studio. The new studio aims to discover the potential of game titles and support projects from development to long-term expansion, with a focus on small creators and teams.
